title: 第19章 虎君第20章 敖正相助
content_zh:
院内。
一道身影，迅速扑向中年女人。
“啊……”
中年女人一声惨叫，被那黑影撞倒。
做完这一切。
孙悟空拍了拍手，看向陆生：
“嘿嘿！”
“搞定！”
陆生走到中年女人面前，皱眉道：
“你到底害了多少人了？”
中年女人目光凶狠地看向陆生二人：
“你们两个死定了，竟敢与山君大人为敌。”
听到中年女人的话。
孙悟空嘿嘿一笑：
“劳烦这位嫂子，告诉俺那位山君在哪里。”
“俺也想去见见那位山君！”
听到孙悟空的话。
中年女人瞪着他：
“不知死活的猴妖！”
“山君大人早已踏入地仙之境。”

“岂是你一小小猴妖，能够挑衅的？”
孙悟空和陆生对视一眼。
地仙？
这倒是没有出乎他们的意料。
刚刚那僵尸中年男人，实力并不弱。
差不多有着“炼神返虚”
后期的实力！
这样的实力，不要说是放在凡人世界。
就是放在那些宗门里，也是顶尖强者了！
能炼出这等行尸的虎妖，实力肯定不弱。
若是只有陆生一人，自然不会招惹那山君。
但现在还有孙悟空在。
哪怕现在的孙悟空，还没有习得任何仙法。
但对付普通地仙也是绰绰有余了！
见中年女人似乎不愿说出山君的位置所在。
陆生看向孙悟空，摇头道：
“算了！”
“大哥，放她走吧！”
听到陆生的话。
那中年女人冷笑：

“你们两个差点死在我手里。”
“会这么好心放了我？”
陆生瞥了她一眼，平静道：
content_en:
In the courtyard.
A figure quickly pounced on the middle-aged woman.
"Ah..."
The middle-aged woman screamed and was knocked down by the black shadow.
Do it all.
Sun Wukong clapped his hands and looked at Lu Sheng:
"Hey!"
"Done!"
Lu Sheng walked up to the middle-aged woman, frowned and said:
"How many people have you killed?"
The middle-aged woman looked at the two Lu Sheng men fiercely:
"You two are doomed, how dare you make an enemy of Mr. Tiger."
Hear what the middle-aged woman said.
Sun Wukong chuckled:
"Sister-in-law, please tell me where the tiger is."
"I also want to meet that tiger!"
Hear what Sun Wukong said.
The middle-aged woman stared at him:
"The monkey demon who doesn't know whether to live or die!"
"Master Tiger has already entered the realm of earthly immortals."
"How can you, a little monkey demon, be able to provoke me?"
Sun Wukong and Lu Sheng looked at each other.
Earthly Immortal?
This was not beyond their expectations.
The zombie middle-aged man just now is not weak.
There is almost "refining the gods and returning to the void"
Later strength!
Such strength cannot be said to be placed in the mortal world.
Even among those sects, he is still a top powerhouse!
A tiger demon that can create such a walking corpse is certainly not weak.
If Lu Sheng was the only one, he would naturally not provoke that tiger.
But now Sun Wukong is still here.
Even now Sun Wukong has not learned any immortal skills.
But it is more than enough to deal with ordinary earth immortals!
The middle-aged woman seemed unwilling to reveal the tiger's location.
Lu Sheng looked at Sun Wukong, shook his head and said:
"Forget it!"
"Brother, let her go!"
Hear what Lu Sheng said.
The middle-aged woman sneered:
"You two almost died in my hands."
"Would you be so kind as to let me go?"
Lu Sheng glanced at her and said calmly:
